title: Social News Feed
summary: A news feed has to answer 'what should this person see right now?' for hundreds of millions of people. Most feeds use a hybrid. A normal user's post is fanned out on write into each follower's precomputed timeline, but a celebrity's post would mean 50 million writes, so those are pulled at read time instead. The reader's feed merges both, ranks them, and loads the post bodies.

walkthrough.title: Publish a post
walkthrough.text: A user posts a photo. The post service stores it durably and assigns a time-sortable ID (Snowflake-style), so IDs sort by creation time.

walkthrough.title: Emit PostCreated
walkthrough.text: An event goes onto a queue so fan-out happens asynchronously. The author's request returns immediately.

walkthrough.title: Look up followers
walkthrough.text: Fan-out workers page through the author's followers from the social graph. If the author has millions of followers, fan-out is skipped and the post is fetched at read time instead.

walkthrough.title: Fan out on write
walkthrough.text: For each follower, the post ID is pushed onto their timeline list in Redis, capped at about 800 entries. Inactive followers can be skipped to save work.

walkthrough.title: Open the feed
walkthrough.text: A reader opens the app. The feed service reads their precomputed timeline, a list of post IDs, in a single fast call.

walkthrough.title: Merge and hydrate
walkthrough.text: Recent posts from the celebrities the reader follows are pulled and merged in. The post service then returns bodies, counts, and author info for the candidate IDs in a batch.

walkthrough.title: Rank and return
walkthrough.text: A ranking model orders posts by predicted engagement rather than pure recency, removes blocked or deleted items, and returns the first page with a cursor for the next.

data.label: Mobile / Web Client
responsibilities: Publishes posts and loads the feed page by page.
Caches the last feed so the app opens instantly, then refreshes.
Prefetches the next page and media while the user scrolls.

failureModes.scenario: Offset pagination while new posts arrive
failureModes.impact: Duplicates or skipped posts while scrolling.
failureModes.mitigation: Cursor-based pagination anchored on post ID or rank snapshot.
Show the cached feed and low-res images first.

data.label: Feed API
responsibilities: Routes writes to the post service and reads to feed assembly.
Applies per-user rate limits on posting.
Shapes the response for each client version.

failureModes.mitigation: Autoscale stateless tiers; serve cached pages; degrade ranking to recency.

failureModes.impact: Fan-out amplifies spam into millions of timelines.
failureModes.mitigation: Posting rate limits and spam checks before fan-out.

data.label: Post Service

output.name: Post data
output.type: { id, author, text, mediaUrls, likeCount, createdAt }

responsibilities: Stores posts durably, sharded by post ID or author.
Serves batched lookups with a large cache in front.
Keeps each author's recent posts for the pull side of the hybrid.

failureModes.scenario: Viral post: hot key in cache
failureModes.mitigation: Replicate hot keys across nodes and add a small in-process cache.
Filter at hydration; lazy cleanup of timeline entries.

data.label: Feed Assembly & Ranking
responsibilities: Merges pushed timeline entries with pulled celebrity posts.
Ranks by predicted engagement, recency, and relationship strength.
Removes blocked, muted, deleted, or already-seen posts.

failureModes.mitigation: Fall back to reverse-chronological order of the candidates.
Integrity signals and quality guardrails in the objective.

data.label: Fan-out Workers
responsibilities: Pushes each new post ID to every follower's timeline.
Skips authors over a follower threshold; they are pulled at read time.
Prioritises active followers so they see posts first.

failureModes.mitigation: Scale workers on lag; deliver to active users first.

failureModes.impact: Some followers miss the post or get it twice.
failureModes.mitigation: Checkpoint progress per batch; timeline writes deduplicate on post ID.

data.label: Timeline Cache
responsibilities: Holds a precomputed list of post IDs per user, IDs only and not bodies, to save memory.
Makes the read path a single O(1) lookup.
Is rebuilt from the graph and posts when a user returns after a long absence.

failureModes.mitigation: Replicas, plus rebuild on read by pulling from followees.

failureModes.impact: Paying to store timelines nobody reads.
failureModes.mitigation: Only maintain timelines for recently active users; others are built when they return.

data.label: Social Graph

output.name: Edges
output.type: Paged user ID lists + follower counts

responsibilities: Stores follow relationships in both directions.
Pages through millions of followers efficiently for fan-out.
Tells fan-out which authors are celebrities by follower count.

failureModes.impact: A user sees posts from someone they unfollowed.
failureModes.mitigation: Re-check follow status at read and hydration time.

failureModes.scenario: Celebrity's follower list on one shard
failureModes.impact: That shard is hammered on each post.
failureModes.mitigation: Pull model for celebrities; split large follower lists across shards.
